log_level.description: The logging level for plover. Options: debug, info, warning, error.

gui.description: The GUI toolkit to use. Options: wx, gtk, qt5, or 'auto' to let plover choose.

interface_host.description: The IP address for the remote control interface.

interface_port.description: The port number for the remote control interface.

dictionary_paths.description: A list of file paths to Plover JSON dictionaries to load at startup.

profile_path.description: Path to a specific user profile file (.json). Empty string uses the default.

hardware_emulation.description: Whether to emulate a hardware steno machine. If false, uses keyboard input.

steno_port.description: The device path for the hardware steno interface (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0).

plugin_list.description: A list of plugin module names to load. Example: ['plover_dictionary_manager'].
